key.name: monospace-font
key.description: Pango font description used by the source view and the terminal, for example "JetBrains Mono 12". An empty string follows the system monospace font.

key.name: recent-projects
key.description: Absolute paths of the project folders opened most recently, newest first. Trimmed to the ten most recent entries.

key.name: restore-last-project
key.summary: Reopen the last project at startup
key.description: Whether starting zcode without a path argument reopens the project that was open most recently.

key.name: style-scheme
key.description: Identifier of the GtkSourceView style scheme used by the editor. An empty string follows the system light/dark preference, selecting the bundled Adwaita Pastel pair.

key.name: tab-width
key.summary: Width of a tab stop, in characters
key.description: Also the width of one indentation level.

key.name: insert-spaces
key.description: Whether pressing Tab inserts spaces up to the next tab stop rather than a tab character.

key.name: wrap-lines
key.description: Whether lines wider than the viewport wrap onto the next display line instead of scrolling horizontally.

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.description: Whether the editor gutter shows line numbers.

key.name: right-margin
key.description: Column at which the editor draws a right-margin guide. Zero hides the guide.
